name: Smooth follow with look-ahead and a shoulder offset
body: Replace the rigid orbit in third-person-camera.nyx with a rig whose pivot eases toward the player (critically damped, frame-rate independent), leads the player's horizontal velocity by a small amount, and sits to one shoulder. Look-ahead is limited so quick turns do not whip the view. Collision stays a sphere-cast, but from the player's head to the shifted pivot first, then from the pivot out to the lens, so the shoulder offset cannot push the lens through a wall. When the shoulder side is blocked, the camera swaps sides smoothly.

comments.text: Done in third-person-camera.nyx. The camera room test found the pivot-touching-a-wall bug (boom collapsed to 0.6 m in one frame); fixed with a 0.1 m skin (D-135).

acceptance_criteria: The pivot follows with no jitter at 60 and 144 fps
The camera never ends inside geometry with the shoulder offset on
A host test steps the rig with and without a wall beside the player
